# descope_admin_portal (Resource)

Manages the project's admin portal configuration. This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this configuration belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Admin Portal is enabled. At least one widget must be listed in the `widgets` attribute when this is set to `true`.
- `style_id` (String) The name of the style the Admin Portal uses. Styles are defined in the project theme, which can be managed with the `descope_styles` resource. When left empty, the default style is used.
- `widgets` (Attributes List) The widgets to show in the Admin Portal, in display order. The `widget_id` values usually reference widgets managed with the `descope_widget` resource, e.g., `widget_id = descope_widget.mywidget.widget_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widgets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--widgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widgets`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of the Widget
- `widget_id` (String) The unique identifier of the Widget
